command_or_source: Manual GUI and physical keyboard verification against build/Tocode.app produced by bash scripts/build.sh from app commit 363ea676afba5d03d55cfd389a4285a04727e736. Not executed in this run.
result_summary: The required manual sequence was not executed: launch the built app, grant Accessibility, open mac > 键盘 > 新增, record a source combination, switch the target segment to 映射功能, pick 向左切换桌面, save, confirm the rule is listed with the 源 → 向左切换桌面 tooltip and the arrow.left.square icon, press the source combination on a multi-desktop session and confirm the desktop actually moves left, repeat for 向右切换桌面, then edit and delete the rule and confirm restoration after relaunch. Whether a synthesized Control-Left / Control-Right posted at the HID tap with the Tocode marker is honored by the operating system as a Mission Control space switch is still unverified; if it is not honored, the wp-037 stop condition applies and the implementation approach must return for re-selection rather than switching to a private Space API.
limitations: Native status-bar menu, modal recorder, segmented control and radio button interactions require an interactive app session.
Real global event interception and space switching require Accessibility permission, physical keyboard input and a session with more than one desktop.

The machine's com.apple.symbolichotkeys lists space-switching hotkeys 79/80/81/82 as enabled with empty parameter lists, which confirms the defaults are in force but does not identify which id maps to which direction; direction mapping is only observable on a real desktop switch.
